title: Customer checks out at a server-computed total

card.i_want: to review my cart, address, coupon, shipping and net total before paying
card.so_that: I pay exactly what the system computed, not a tampered client value

context: Totals are computed server-side; shipping is free at >= 1500 THB else 60 THB; one coupon, floored at 0; the coupon is re-validated at confirm and a double-click yields exactly one order.

acceptance_criteria.scenario_name: server-computed total with coupon and shipping
given: a cart subtotal of 1200 THB with coupon WELCOME100 (-100) and an in-region address
then: the server computes total = 1160 THB (1200 - 100 + 60 shipping)
an order is created in awaiting-payment with reserved stock

given: a coupon that expired while the customer browsed
then: the order is rejected with the neutral message 'this coupon is no longer valid'
no order is created and no stock is reserved

given: a confirm already accepted for this idempotency key
then: no second order, reservation or charge is created

given: any confirm that creates an order
then: an audit event {event, actor, ts, order_id, total, audit_id} is emitted

pii_fields.justification: the chosen shipping address is direct PII
pii_fields.treatment: snapshotted into the order; redacted in non-order logs

audit_events.justification: order creation is a financial event

idempotency.justification: double-click must not create duplicate orders/charges

reversibility.justification: a confirm that fails downstream must release reserved stock
reversibility.compensating_action: release the stock reserved by this confirm

authn_authz.justification: the cart and address must belong to the confirming customer

regulatory.justification: Consumer Protection Act / Electronic Transactions Act require the total be shown before payment; resolved
